Each identity locks one engine block, forged once with a unique serial in its steel and held in a bonded yard. One block backs exactly one identity, never two; a raven-black drone photographs the serial.

A fake costs 4,200 units locked 180 days plus a 150-unit fee, spent not returned. One hundred cost 420,000 units locked 180 days and 15,000 in fees, a ripple of frozen capital.

Cheapest is renting: a dealer rents a block for 900 units per 180 days, or a clerk takes 1,200 to record one block twice. One hundred rented cost 90,000 units, and a double entry dies at the next drone re-check.
